parts.fixed: what a transaction pays before any data or execution: the transaction base, per-frame and value-transfer costs
parts.calldata: every data byte of the transaction at the price of the path that binds; `signature_calldata` is the signature bytes alone times `signature_byte_price`
parts.verification: what is charged for checking the signature: EVM verifier execution, the enshrined scheme's gas, or the per-dependency charge; 0 when the calldata floor binds and execution is not charged on top (`verification_executed` has what runs)
parts.overhead: the rest of the execution: account, module or EntryPoint code, the frames, the user's action

rule: a transaction pays the larger of the standard path (calldata at the standard price plus execution) and the calldata floor; `binds` names it and `parts` splits it, in whole gas that sums to `total`

agg8288.verification: [E] per dependency: 3,000 leanSPHINCS verification plus 30,000 recursive STARK gas in EIP-8288 (33,000); 3,000 in the leanPCS draft

pcs.calldata: [Mo on R] proof calldata 1,005 B, frame 193 B and 64 B of claim (key, message) per signature; 64 gas per byte when the floor binds, 16 for the claims on the standard path
pcs.verification: [R] the proof-checking transaction of the leanPCS repository without its base (57,883 at 128 signatures, 58,669 at 400): execution and its own proof calldata, not split by the source
